packs.source: EventMate draft, general public knowledge about Jain food practice; not reviewed by members of the community

items.title: Confirm a Jain-compliant kitchen
items.detail: Ask the caterer to confirm in writing that Jain dishes use no onion, garlic or root vegetables.

items.title: Ask about separate preparation and service
items.detail: Ask whether Jain dishes are cooked and served with separate utensils and a separate counter.

items.title: Confirm meal timing with the host family
items.detail: Some Jain families prefer meals to finish before sunset; confirm the serving time with the host family.

packs.source: EventMate draft, general public knowledge about halal catering; not reviewed by members of the community

items.title: Ask for halal certification or the meat source
items.detail: Ask the caterer for a halal certificate or the name of the halal-certified supplier.

items.title: Confirm cooking ingredients with the host
items.detail: Confirm with the host whether alcohol-based ingredients or flavourings must be excluded from the menu.

packs.source: EventMate draft, general public knowledge about vegan catering; not reviewed by a nutrition professional

items.title: Check for hidden animal products
items.detail: Ask for an ingredient list: ghee, paneer, curd, cream, honey and gelatine are common in Indian menus and desserts.

packs.source: EventMate draft, general public knowledge about vegetarian catering; not reviewed by a nutrition professional

items.title: Confirm separate vessels and no egg or gelatine
items.detail: Ask whether vegetarian dishes are prepared in separate vessels and whether desserts contain egg or gelatine.

packs.source: EventMate draft, general public knowledge about gluten-free catering; not reviewed by a nutrition professional

items.title: Ask about cross-contamination
items.detail: Ask whether gluten-free dishes share a kitchen, fryer or serving spoons with wheat, maida or semolina dishes, and whether sauces contain wheat.
